rationale: Settings adjusted to conservative levels: reference_yield_quantile raised to 0.85 to focus on high-performing baselines; stress_score_threshold increased to 1.2 to filter out mild anomalies; max_water_proxy_shift_fraction reduced to 0.3 to limit counterfactual water manipulation within realistic bounds; max_actionable_features set to 3 to prioritize the most critical stressors among the available weather, soil, and remote-sensing predictors; top_reported_stresses limited to 6 to ensure clarity given the small dataset size (n=88).
